commentary_segments.text_raw:
Current reuse can also be
effectuated in another way.
If a two-stage amplifier is
required, or an amplifier fol-
lowed by a source follower,
then current is used twice,
as shown on the right.
However, a judicious set
of capacitors allows limiting
the current to just one single
path. This is shown on the
left.
Transistor M1 sees a
signal ground at its Source.
Its output is coupled to the
Source follower underneath.
The same technique is used three times in the following LNA.
commentary_segments.text: Current reuse can also be effectuated in another way. If a two-stage amplifier is required, or an amplifier followed by a source follower, then current is used twice, as shown on the right. However, a judicious set of capacitors allows limiting the current to just one single path. This is shown on the left. Transistor M1 sees a signal ground at its Source. Its output is coupled to the Source follower underneath. The same technique is used three times in the following LNA.
